params.body:
## What changes

**The transport window answers first.** The confirm and pay step (and the transport detail, which renders the same partial) used to open on a column of bold labels, with the price last in a dark slab, the country in English ("Belgium"), a red cross for "no express" and an italic red-pink "Prijs beschikbaar" badge. Now it opens with one sentence:

> Transport van StockCars naar Garage De Backer, **€ 257,73** incl. btw.

Under that sentence the request is read back as facts. Labels are in rank three and regular weight, values are in ink, and the addresses and the vehicle are set in 500. Each address is one line with its country in the reader's language (`Country::localizedName`, the same code the relations page already uses). The three dimensions are one line, "4155 × 1765 × 1648 mm (l × b × h)". Express and the handover report are plain "Ja" or "Nee", with the report's explanation as a short note. The price follows once more as a right-aligned total in tabular figures, and the state is a calm badge.

**Same address.** If pick-up and delivery are the same place, the window asks "Ophaal- en leveradres zijn hetzelfde. Klopt dat?" in amber above the buttons. Same place means street, number with addition, postcode and country, compared without case, spaces or punctuation; the names do not count. The question only appears while the request can still be cancelled, and it never blocks paying (`Transport::hasSameAddresses`, new rule R S4-10.22).

**Buttons.** "Bevestig en betaal" is the one primary button and "Terug" is a plain button. "Aanvraag annuleren" is now red text, and it asks `ui.confirm` before it posts. Before this change it cancelled on the first click. The header keeps its ×, because "Terug" goes back to the form and does not close the window.

**One state colour.** `Transport::stateTone()` is the only mapping from state to colour. It reads the colour the transport overview has always shown. The overview's badge, the badge in the window and the truck on an order row all use it.

**The truck on order rows** (Bestelbonnen, Dealertransacties): until now it was a solid filled block in the state colour, and the state appeared only in the tooltip. It is now the same square as the eye next to it, softly tinted in the state's palette, with the icon in the deep shade and a subtle ring (`ui-action-button--tint-{tone}`). The tooltip and the aria-label give the state in words plus the action ("Prijs beschikbaar, transport bekijken"). Without a transport it is the neutral button, labelled "Transport aanvragen". Which URL opens has not changed.

## App-wide pieces

These live in `resources/views/components/ui/` (README added) and are styled in a new Vite entry, `resources/css/ui.css`, which every app layout loads:

- `x-ui.answer`: the opening sentence; only the number in it is bold (600).
- `x-ui.facts` + `x-ui.fact`: the label and value list (`key` sets the value in 500, `note` adds a line under it).
- `x-ui.badge`: one badge component, now with a `dot`. The two `.ui-badge` definitions in refresh.css are merged into ui.css.
- `x-ui.callout`: a one-line warning in amber, or a grey remark.
- `x-ui.total`: the total line.
- `.ui-text-action` (`--danger`) and `.ui-action-button--tint-*`.

**Tokens:** the type scale (12 to 30), the three ink ranks, spacing in steps of 4 and the state palette now live once in `ui.css`. Inzichten's `--ins-*` tokens read them through `var(--ui-*)`, so no value appears twice. `UiDesignSystemTest` holds ui.css to the same rules as Inzichten: sizes on the scale, spacing in fours, weights 400, 500 and 600, no spaced capitals and no italics. refresh.css shrinks from 6,102 to 6,079 lines (ratchet lowered).

## Also

- Translations for nl, fr, en and de. Fixed: "( foto's" spacing in nl, fr and de `inclVat` (was English), de `price`.
- Mails that print the transport addresses now get the one-line format with the localized country too.
- Business rules: R S4-10.22 is new (the confirmation screen and the same-address question). R S4-10.17 now describes the tinted truck and its tooltip.

## Tests

- `TransportConfirmationAnswersFirstTest`: the answer sentence with pickup, delivery and bold price; dimensions, the note, no red cross, no dark slab, the price exactly twice; the badge tone; the country in nl, fr and de; the same-address question only when the addresses match and only before payment; the normalization rules; cancel goes through `ui.confirm`; one primary button; every state's tint and tooltip on the truck, and no tint without a transport.
- `TransportFromADealerTransactionTest` updated to the tint and the new tooltips. `InsightsKeepTheirRulesTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest` and `BuildContractTest` now include ui.css.
- The full suite and PHPStan pass locally.
params.title: Transport window answers first; shared ui pieces and one state colour for a transport
